angeln.title: Shop — shipping from within the EU
angeln.content: Example tackle shop: only stock fishing gear from suppliers who ship from inside the EU. Avoids the legal risk of direct shipping from the Far East. Always provide tracking, and communicate a 1-3 day delivery time.

angeln.title: Trout — bait and technique
angeln.content: Best baits: spinners (size 1-3), 5-7 cm crankbaits, wax worms on a bubble float. Where: current edges, deep pools, below a weir. When: dawn and dusk. Line: 0.18-0.22 mono, fluorocarbon leader.

angeln.title: Knots — clinch and palomar
angeln.content: Clinch: 5-7 turns, back through the loop, wet it, pull tight. Palomar for braid: double the line, tie the knot, pass the hook through the loop. Over 90 % of line strength when tied cleanly.

dropshipping.title: Small-business VAT exemption (§19 UStG, Germany)
dropshipping.content: Under §19 UStG you charge no VAT, and must state on invoices and in the shop: 'Als Kleinunternehmer im Sinne des §19 UStG wird keine Umsatzsteuer berechnet.' Thresholds for 2024: EUR 22,000 in the previous year, EUR 50,000 in the current one. Check the equivalent rule in your own country.

dropshipping.title: Shopify — mandatory legal pages
dropshipping.content: Imprint, privacy policy, terms, right of withdrawal, shipping and payment — keep them current. In Germany, stale pages invite cease-and-desist letters. Address: [your company address]. Contact details and company register entry where applicable.

dropshipping.title: Suppliers — trust beats cheap
dropshipping.content: Warehouse in your own region, tracking required, returns address local, delivery time stated realistically at 2-4 days. Product images without foreign watermarks, descriptions rewritten in your own words, trust badges, reviews moderated.

ki.title: RAG — retrieval augmented generation
ki.content: RAG: chunk documents (400-500 characters), embed them (e.g. nomic-embed-text via Ollama), store the vectors, fetch the top-k at query time and inject them into the prompt. Hybrid: fuse BM25 and cosine with RRF.

ki.title: Ollama locally — setup
ki.content: brew install ollama; ollama pull llama3.2; ollama pull nomic-embed-text; ollama serve. In KEPTA pick the provider 'Ollama (local, free)', no key, model llama3.2, base http://localhost:11434/v1.

ki.title: Prompting — use the context
ki.content: System: 'You are an AI assistant with access to a knowledge base. Answer precisely and cite the id of every node you used. If the context is empty, answer generally but say so.'

coding.title: TypeScript — strict and fast
coding.content: tsconfig: strict, ES2022, bundler resolution. Vite HMR off, tsc --noEmit in CI. Avoid any, use satisfies, handle errors through a Result type.

coding.title: Electron — the tipping points
coding.content: Electron 44, titleBar hiddenInset, getFreePort, Vite middleware in dev and static files in production. shell.openExternal for links, ignore crashpad noise.

studium.title: Study method — active recall
studium.content: Make cards: question on the front, answer as a node. 20 minutes of recall daily, and save every gap immediately as a new node. The graph shows you where the gaps cluster.

forschung.title: Source citations — trust
forschung.content: Every chat answer returns the ids of the nodes it used. In written work, always give id plus title so a reader can check it. Store Zotero keys or DOIs as tags.

business.title: Meeting → tasks
business.content: After every meeting: extract the key point (chat → node), tag it meeting, owner, due. Planned: an agent that creates the task straight from the note.

kreativ.title: Writing — show, don't tell
kreativ.content: Write scenes through all five senses, trim the dialogue, prove every claim. Use nodes as an idea store: one idea, one node, connected by tags.

_base.title: Welcome to KEPTA — local and private
_base.content: No login, no cloud. Everything lives in ~/.kepta/kepta.db on this machine. Back it up through System → JSON export. MCP shares the very same store with Claude and Cursor.

_base.title: Shortcuts
_base.content: ⌘K palette, ⌘N new node, focus the search, open the graph, import. The top-k slider controls how many nodes go into the chat — that is where you save tokens.
